newsitem.title: USA: Durco holders approve BW/IP merger.
newsitem.headline: Durco holders approve BW/IP merger.

text.p: Durco International Inc said Tuesday its shareholders have approved the merger of Durco with BW/IP Inc, and approved changing the name of the company to Flowserve Corp.

Under the terms of the transaction, which is expected to close immediately, Durco shareholders retained their shares and BW/IP shareholders received 0.6968 shares of Durco common stock for each previously owned share of BW/IP.
Flowserve Corp begins trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday under the symbol FLS.N.
The company also said Bernard Rethore will become chairman and chief executive of Flowserve. He was chairman, president and CEO of BW/IP.
William Jordan will become president and chief operating officer of Flowserve. He was chairman, president and CEO of Durco.
Bruce Hines has been named vice president and chief financial officer. He was previously senior vice president, CFO and chief administrative officer of Durco.
The company said it expects to begin relocating to a new corporate headquarters in Dallas in December.
